rejected_rule.statement: The Court has an inherent right to summon a party before it, and, if that summons be disregarded without lawful excuse, to enforce obedience by warrant.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: I am of the same opinion. I think also that this order might be supported by the terms of sections 137 and 141 of the Civil Procedure Code without coming into contact with the decision of the Full Court in the case reported in 1 N. L. R. 49. The Court has an inherent right to summon a party before it, and, if that summons be disregarded without lawful excuse, to enforce obedience by warrant.
